description: This file defines the WebKit class extending BrowserType, implementing methods for connecting, environment setup, logging, closing, and argument generation for the WebKit browser in Playwright. It also includes a utility function for translating paths to WSL.

classes.name: WebKit
classes.description: A class representing the WebKit browser type, with methods to connect, configure environment, handle logs, close, and generate startup arguments.

methods.name: connectToTransport
methods.description: Connects to a transport and returns a WKBrowser instance.

methods.name: amendEnvironment
methods.description: Modifies environment variables for WebKit, especially setting the cookie jar path on Windows when persistent.

methods.name: doRewriteStartupLog
methods.description: Rewrites startup logs to include an ASCII box message if display errors are detected.

methods.name: attemptToGracefullyCloseBrowser
methods.description: Sends a message to close the browser gracefully via the transport.

methods.name: defaultArgs
methods.description: Generates default command-line arguments for launching WebKit, considering options like headless, user data directory, proxy, and platform specifics.
